name: Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro — husband Pietro Dondero and a daughter born 1883 at Genova
researcher_question: Was the Carmela Cavagnaro who bore a daughter, Maria Clementina Angelica Gentile Dondero, at Genova on 30 August 1883 with Pietro Dondero the same woman as Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro, born 1866 in Lima?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 21, hint-samples.csv row 640, flags adds_spouse/adds_daughter, confidence 3). Adjudicated as a FALSE MATCH (spec 3.6 outcome (c)): the Carmela Cavagnaro named as mother in the 1883 Genovese birth entry (ark:/61903/1:1:6BHW-1HG3) is a different woman, identified by the civil marriage entry for Pietro Dondero and Carmela Cavagnaro (ark:/61903/1:1:X3TM-QPSS). No substitute husband or child was found for the subject. Second opinion: Ikennaya Mbadiwe. The subject's parents are Giuseppe Cavagnaro and Maddalena Boitano; the Angelo Vaglio / Maria Fereccio pair in the starting tree is a mis-attachment from three Paolo Andrea Vaglio sources and was deliberately left uncorrected upstream. The batch CSV labels this row Peru; the records are Genovese and the fixture is tagged IT.
